Context: (i) DA on Tour.-

- (ii) Reimbursement of Hotel charges.For levels 8 and below, the amount of claim (up to the ceiling) may be paid without production of vouchers against self-certified claim only. The self-certified claim should clearly indicate the period of stay, name of dwelling, etc. Additionally, for stay in Class 'X' cities, the ceiling for all employees up to Level 8 would be ~ 1,000 per day, but it will only be in the form of reimbursement upon production of relevant vouchers.
